Container.Name: Groschen
Container.Overview: Private finance dashboard for ING Germany. Syncs your accounts over FinTS, categorizes on this server with a built-in model, and never connects to anything but your bank. Everything is set up in the web page.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port for the web page. Don't forward it on your router; use Tailscale or WireGuard from outside.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Database, the key that protects your bank PIN, and nightly backups.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the sync and backup schedule.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: The app runs as this user (99 is Unraid's nobody).

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: The app runs with this group (100 is Unraid's users).
